title: Seva
sub: Border tax, WhatsApp group and more

wa.title: Our WhatsApp Group
wa.step1: Tap the button below and send this message on WhatsApp to {number}.
wa.step2: Our team will send you the group link in the same chat.
wa.step3: Open the link and send the join request — it gets approved instantly and you're in the group.
wa.sub: Our WhatsApp group — the same rides, right in WhatsApp
wa.needProfile: Complete your profile first — the admin approves you by your name.
wa.sameNumber: Send the message from the WhatsApp number you want to add to the group.

bt.title: Border Tax
bt.periodEnd: {mode} — valid till the period ends (date set by the govt portal)
bt.declare: I confirm these vehicle details are correct and accept the govt portal's declaration.
bt.freeNote: Free for members — you pay only the govt tax, on the official payment page.
bt.historyEmpty: Your border tax filings will show here.

filling.s: Filling the govt portal for you

awaiting_captcha.s: Type the code shown to continue

handed_off.s: Paid? Get your receipt from the official site

fail.captcha_timeout: The code wasn't typed in time. Please file again.
fail.captcha_wrong: The code was wrong too many times. Please file again.
fail.portal_error: The govt portal had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
fail.worker_restart: The govt portal had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
fail.vehicle_pending: A payment for this vehicle is unfinished on the govt site. File again once the lock clears.
fail.already_paid: Tax is already paid for these dates. Pick another start date.
fail.road_tax_expired: Your road tax has expired. Renew it, then file again.
fail.same_state: This vehicle is registered in this state — no border tax here.
fail.no_tax_mode: The govt site has no tax option for this vehicle at this border. Check that your RC says taxi (MOTOR CAB / MAXI CAB).
fail.bank_down: The state's payment site is down. Try again in a while.
fail.portal_down: The govt border tax site is down or very slow. Try again in a while.
fail.no_handoff: The govt site didn't open the payment page. Try again.
fail.pucc_expired: Your pollution certificate (PUC) has expired. Renew it, then file again.
fail.insurance_expired: Your vehicle's insurance has expired. Renew it, then file again.
fail.fitness_expired: Your fitness certificate has expired. Renew it, then file again.
fail.seat_class_mismatch: Your RC's vehicle class and seats don't match, so tax can't be paid online. Get the RC fixed at the RTO, or pay at the border.
fail.vehicle_not_found: The govt Vahan site has no record of this number. Check it on your RC.
fail.no_qr: The govt payment page showed no QR. Try again in a while.
fail.treasury_down: The govt payment site is down. Try again in a while.
fail.payment_failed: The payment failed. If money was debited, contact support.
fail.payment_timeout: No payment arrived in time. Already paid? Don't pay again — contact support.
fail.payment_unknown: The payment couldn't be confirmed. Already paid? Don't pay again — contact support.
fail.alreadyPaidS: Tax for {from} – {to} is already paid. Pick a later start date.
fail.fare_declined: You stopped at the amount. File again whenever you like.

live.captchaSub: Our reader couldn't read this one. Type exactly what you see, including # or @.
live.closedSub: The payment link lasts about 5 minutes. If you didn't pay, the portal holds this vehicle for about 30 minutes — file again after that.

gate.title: Seva is for members
gate.sub: Border tax and our WhatsApp group are free with membership.

errors.vehicleBusy: This vehicle already has a filing in progress — see History.
errors.rateLimited: Too many filings. Try again in an hour.
errors.busy: Govt site is busy. Try again in {time}
errors.portalDown: The govt border tax site is down right now. You'll get a notification as soon as it's back.

prep.title: Preparing your border tax payment
prep.keepOpenS: Don't close or leave this screen. Your payment details will appear here automatically.
prep.queued: Starting soon — the govt site allows one lookup every 2 minutes
prep.startsIn: Starting in {time} — the govt site allows one lookup every 2 minutes

pay.title: Payment Details
pay.note: Opens the official govt payment page in a new tab. The link works for about 5 minutes. If a govt treasury page opens first, tap Continue there. EaseCab charges nothing.

fee.mine: This cab's last fee in this state: {amount} for {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

fare.label: Govt fee
fare.sub: If you continue and don't pay, the govt site locks this vehicle for about 30 minutes.

qr.title: Pay Border Tax
qr.scan: Pay directly through UPI — scan from another phone, or tap Pay on this phone.
qr.wait: Keep this screen open after paying — we'll fetch your govt receipt here.
qr.noReceipt: Paid, but the govt receipt didn't load. Contact support and we'll get it for you.
qr.saveHint: Save it to your phone now — we delete it from EaseCab on {date}, {time}.
qr.receiptGone: Receipt deleted from EaseCab 24 hours after the tax validity ended. Use the copy saved on your phone.
qr.gettingReceipt: Paid. Getting your receipt from the govt site…
qr.expired: QR time is over. Checking if a payment came through…
qr.verifying: If you've paid, please wait a little — your receipt is being fetched from the govt portal. This can take a few minutes.
qr.noRepay: Don't pay again. Keep this screen open, or check Border Tax history for the receipt later.
qr.scanCaps: Scan & pay with any UPI app
qr.beforeS: If you don't pay in time, this QR expires and the govt site holds this vehicle for about 30 minutes before you can file again.

unlock.error: Couldn't start. Try again in a minute.
unlock.queued: Clearing the lock on the govt portal now…
unlock.waiting: The portal frees this vehicle at {time}, then the lock is cleared. If you already paid on the portal yourself, don't pay again.
unlock.cleared: Lock cleared. You can file again now.
unlock.paid: The earlier payment went through. Receipt no. {no}
unlock.failed: The portal didn't release the lock. Please contact support.

issues.vehicle: Enter a valid vehicle number, e.g. PB10AB1234
issues.sameState: This vehicle is registered in this state — border tax is only for vehicles from other states.
issues.start: Pick a date from now up to 7 days ahead

confirm.title: Confirm your tax validity
confirm.sub: With this start date, the tax is valid only until the date below.

late.title: Border tax paid
late.sub: Payment received for {vehicle} ({state}). Your receipt is ready.

bt.siteDown: The govt border tax site is down right now. Filing won't go through until it's back.

fuel.title: Fuel & CNG near you
fuel.confirmed: {days, plural, =0 {CNG confirmed today by a driver} one {CNG confirmed 1 day ago} other {CNG confirmed # days ago}}
fuel.empty: No pumps found within 15 km yet. Add one you know below.
fuel.error: Couldn't load pumps. Please try again.

geo.denied: Location is blocked. Allow location for EaseCab in your phone settings.
geo.failed: Couldn't get your location. Turn on GPS and try again.

add.title: Add a pump
add.sub: Stand at the pump and add it. Our team checks it before it shows to everyone.
add.name: Pump name
add.here: Your current location will be saved as the pump's location.
add.done: Pump sent for review. Thank you!
add.limit: You can add up to 5 pumps a day.

fuel.disclaimer: Pump list from oil companies and drivers. Stock can change — check before a long trip. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

map.label: Map of pumps
map.error: Map couldn't load. The list below still works.
map.locateFailed: Couldn't get your location. Turn on GPS and allow location.

route.needFrom: Location is off. Pick a starting city.

route.approx: Road map unavailable right now — showing {count, plural, =0 {no pumps} one {1 pump} other {# pumps}} near a straight line between the two places.
